entry.title: Grainbloom 1.0.0
entry.summary: First release of Grainbloom, a granular texture and micro-loop effect for MPC standalone. **What it does** - Seven modes: Collage, Cloud, Stutter, Shimmer, Shatter, Arpeggio and Cascade. - Grain, Scatter, Space and Mix macros on an animated BLOOM page, with every setting on the CONTROLS page. - Tempo sync, freeze, feedback, filters and a dense plate/hall reverb (Room, Hall, Plate, Dark). - 17 built-in presets. **Requirements** - MPC OS 3.10.1 or later. - Preferences → Enhancements (Beta): turn o
